White Pocket

A swirl of pale sandstone domes tucked into Arizona's remote backcountry.

Marble Canyon, Arizona

About

White Pocket feels like a sculpted field of whipped stone, with layered rock forms that twist into pockets and bright ridges.

Know Before You Go

Road conditions can shift quickly after storms, so high-clearance travel is often recommended.
